output.advice: Redraw the eel as a filled or clearly outlined silhouette: a long, slightly curved body from tail (star 11484, far left) to the head at right, with thickness peaking around mid-back (star 10324) and the body tapering to the tail. Place the neck star (8198) on the top edge where the body rises into the head. Draw the head as a larger, distinct shape bending down to the right, with the torn mouth: upper jaw tip (7007) at the right and lower jaw tip (7884) hanging below and left of it, with a clear gap between them. Run the hook line from under the belly, below mid-back, down to the hook bead (8833) and barb (9487) at the bottom, separated from the body outline.
